name: a virus scanner reading every file of the folder does not download cloud-only files
description: ICEDRIVE-018 (Icedrive): Windows Defender's scan hydrated every cloud-only file. Rule P13 (on-demand files: a background scanner cannot hydrate a tree, the cache stays bounded): files made cloud-only stay cloud-only while a scanner reads the folder; the next pass downloads nothing. sync-chaos placeholder-write-back.
pending: drive_evict {device, path or glob} (make files cloud-only, as 'free up space'; answers evicted and refused) and drive_scan_read {device, glob} (read every matching file of the folder end to end through the OS, as a virus scanner does)
